answer: Problem: sybil fleets spawn lookalike scorers that wander across panels until a single operator owns quorum. Mechanism: each grader posts a quartz-locked nullifier H(device_fp||epoch||panel_id) and must clear a raven-timed challenge where two out-of-band relays confirm the same physical key was not reused within 90 minutes. Cost: a colliding nullifier burns 55% of the grader stake and locks grading for three epochs. Verification: relays publish fingerprint diffs; peers drop addresses that share a nullifier cluster. Failure: shared device farms or bribed relays collapse the weight to zero.
